requirement: Provide a cloud-based solution accessible via web browser and mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Accessible on web and mobile without local install.

requirement: Provide responsive mobile access or a native app for field entry.
acceptance_criteria: Field functions usable on mobile.

requirement: Provide role-based access control and configurable approval workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Permissions configurable per role.

requirement: Provide open, documented APIs / integration capability (payment gateway, banking, biometric, WhatsApp/SMS/email).
acceptance_criteria: Documented API; sample integrations demonstrable.

requirement: Host data (and backups) in India, in line with prevailing data-protection regulations.
acceptance_criteria: India region confirmed for data and backups.

requirement: Be configurable without heavy custom coding wherever possible; low-code extensibility preferred.
acceptance_criteria: Common changes done by configuration.

requirement: Encrypt data in transit and at rest (database and file storage).
acceptance_criteria: TLS in transit; encryption at rest incl. files.

requirement: Provide multi-factor authentication, enforceable for privileged roles.
acceptance_criteria: MFA available and enforceable for finance/admin.

requirement: Maintain audit trails on financial and approval actions.
acceptance_criteria: Immutable logs on key actions.

requirement: Provide data backup and disaster-recovery provisions with a tested restore.
acceptance_criteria: Backups scheduled; restore SLA stated and tested.

requirement: Meet a target uptime of 99.5% or better with defined maintenance windows.
acceptance_criteria: Uptime SLA committed.

requirement: State included cloud-storage capacity, additional-storage cost/slab, scalability and retention.
acceptance_criteria: Storage capacity and overage rate stated.

requirement: Scale to support growth in users, projects and transaction volume to the target turnover without re-platforming.
acceptance_criteria: No re-platforming needed to reach target scale.

requirement: Notify GESPL of a security incident/breach within a defined window.
acceptance_criteria: Notification window committed in contract.

requirement: Ensure GESPL owns all data with export and secure deletion on exit.
acceptance_criteria: Data export any time; deletion on exit confirmed.
